acceptance_predicates.description: ASB install/materialization and asb-tui lifecycle consume one explicit channel value, defaulting fresh installs to dev.
The selected channel survives status, launch, upgrade, restart, and JSON projections without silent fallback.
Stable, nightly, and experimental remain typed unavailable choices until implemented.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management are warning-only and never block.

definition_of_done: Paired ASB/TUI contract implementation is merged or the existing implementation is proven exact-current-main.
Independent review and required hosted checks are green.

inputs.description: ASB channel command surface and materializer.
asb-tui channel selection and lifecycle projection.

gates.description: Exact-head ASB/TUI channel contract tests pass.
Required hosted checks pass on exact reviewed heads.
